differences.what: massing: a front block of three storeys the width of the lot's building (10.4 m on the 1911 sheet) with a long brick range behind it running back along the south flank; the draft stood a 7.25 m flat-topped box with no bay, oriel or entrance, its front 1.2 m short of the sheet's width
differences.how: T-2541: K01 front block at the sheet's own 10.4 m width and 7.57 m depth; the 8.4 m brick range of three storeys and the two-storey rear section on K01's rear wings, 18.4 m back; the front's edges land at x 50 and 625 px against the plate's 50 and 615

differences.what: the north bay: the front's north part stands forward of the entrance block, its front about 3.7 m wide with two windows a storey, iron-grilled basement lights, and a cornice at about 8.3 m; nothing in the draft
differences.how: T-2541: K08 full-height projection 3.7 m wide and 1.0 m proud, two storeys to 8.4 m; its front lands at x 85-295 px against the plate's 112-287, its windows about 20 px north of the plate's

differences.what: storey lines: the bay's ground-floor sills 2.0 m and heads 4.3 m, first-floor 5.5-7.6 m; the third storey's lights over the bay at about 9.0-9.9 m
differences.how: T-2541: principal floor 1.35 m, storeys 3.65 m and (T-2542) a second storey carried up as the roof storey's knee wall to the 9.14 m eave datum; the ground and first-floor windows within about 15 px of the plate's; the third storey's three lights, now in the bay's stone gable (T-2542), at 9.39-10.29 m, about 0.4 m over the plate's (a wall gable's face stands on the eave datum)

differences.what: the entrance: the door under a round arch in the south part of the front, reached by a broad straight stair of about nine risers
differences.how: T-2541: K07's deep-arched double door at s 7.9 m (x 380-425 px against the arch's 360-440), its stair of nine 0.15 m risers between low cheeks

differences.what: the oriel over the entrance arch: corbelled out from about 5.2 m, three tall transomed lights in front and one in each return, its cornice about 9.1 m
differences.how: T-2541: K08 corbelled oriel, 2.8 m across at the wall and 0.5 m out on three corbel courses from 4.4 m, three transomed lights 6.0-8.2 m; it lands at x 310-470 px against the plate's 340-500

differences.what: the bay's north face is CANTED (the sheet draws it, and the plate shows it dark and foreshortened at x 60-112 px, a narrow window a storey); the build stands it flat, as the main wall's north strip with one window a storey, K08 having no canted pavilion (T-2988)

the bay's stone gable: its rake from about 10.2 m to an apex about 13.2 m with a finial, a group of three round-arched lights in an arched recess, corner pinnacles, and the pierced (fretwork) balcony on the bay's top in front of the third storey
differences.how: T-2542: K01's wall gable (T-2428) on the street wall over the bay, behind its deck: its face 3.0 m across, its pediment's cornice at about 10.1-10.3 m and its apex about 13.1 m under a finial (the finial's top about 25 px under the plate's); a pinnacle either side at x 125 and 290 px against the plate's 120 and 285, rising to about 12 m under a pyramid; the three lights in it. What it does not yet carry is a difference of its own below (the recess, the round-arched lights, the balcony)

differences.what: the oriel's steep pyramid with its finial, apex about 12.0 m; T-2541's build carried the K08 kit's low hip
differences.how: T-2542: K08's spire with its finial on the oriel, carried through the eave as 1623's is (T-2778): its apex at x 400 y 270 px against the plate's finial at about 415, 270 px

differences.what: the main roof: the plate's slopes are steep and rise to about 16 m behind the gable and the pyramid, the street slope coming down to about 8.5-8.8 m behind them; T-2541's gable roof was at K01's steepest 45 degrees from an 11.7 m eave, its stone cornice in full view across the front
differences.how: T-2542: the front block's eave datum at 9.14 m (the fascia's top 8.50 m, the moulded stone cornice's top 8.30 m, the plate's bay cornice), the street slope at 61.2 degrees to a ridge at 16.0 m (y 247 px against the plate's apex at 240), the cornice dying into the oriel's cants

differences.what: the brick south flank's front end: the plate and the Chicagology print show the front block's south wall carried up as a coped brick gable to the tall stack, a smooth rake (not crow-stepped), standing a little behind the entrance block's stone return
differences.how: T-2541's coped gable end on K01's 'north' wall, carried up by T-2542 to the steep roof's 16.0 m ridge; the stacks themselves are a difference of their own below

differences.what: the oriel's depth and returns: the plate's oriel stands about 0.6 m out on square returns with a light in each; the build's stands 0.5 m out on canted returns with none, K08's corbel rule holding three courses to 0.52 m; the plate's oriel is a flat-fronted box about 3 m across (x 338-470 px), its south return lit by two or three narrow lights, on a rounded rock-faced base (T-2989)
the bay's basement lights: two large iron-grilled lights under its windows, about 0.1-1.1 m over grade; not built (K08 stacks no second window in a storey; the ironwork is T-1892's)
differences.how: T-2916: K08's bay split at a 1.75 m basement storey, its string course at 1.67-1.83 m on the plate's sill course; under each window a basement light 0.95 m by 1.0 m from 0.22 m (the plate's at y 765-819 px, x 139-184 and 235-272 px: the heads within about 3 px, the sills about 7 px higher, because K06's sill stone must stand on the bay's 0.1 m plinth), barred in K08's grille of five bars and a ring. The plate's scrolled panels are drawn as bars and one scroll

differences.what: the entrance porch: the plate's arch is an open porch, about 1.8 m wide, deep, on clustered columns with carved capitals, the door far back in it; its stair runs between scrolled stone cheek walls; the build has a door in a shallow reveal under a small arch (T-1892)
differences.how: T-2918: the arch is the porch's mouth, 1.9 m across and crowned 2.75 m over the door's floor (4.1 m over grade, about 4 px under the plate's 4.2 m, so its head and ring clear the oriel's corbel foot), its 0.4 m voussoirs to about 4.5 m; behind it K01's loggia (T-2910), 2.3 m along the front and 1.8 m deep from the face, the double door under its transom in the back wall. Each jamb carries a cluster of round shafts (`loggia.columns`, new): two on the north side and three on the south, 0.22 m thick at 0.24 m centres, on a plinth 0.86 m over the floor, each under a necking ring, a flared bell and an abacus at the springing; overlaid on the plate, the south cluster's three shafts land on the plate's three (x 442, 452 and 463 px), the north shaft on its own (x 348), the capitals on the plate's line (y 673-684 px) and the plinths' tops within about 2 px of y 725. The stair's cheeks are K07's scrolled cheek (`cheek_form: scrolled`), swept down to a rolled scroll. The capitals' leafage is not carved: the bell and abacus stand for it

differences.what: the porch's south return: beside the arch, from about x 467 to 507 px, the plate opens the entrance block's south return as a small arcade of round-arched lights on colonnettes with carved capitals, lighting the porch from the side; the build closes it in coursed stone (T-2991); the arcade's capitals (y 680-690 px) and crowns (y 647-660) step down across x 476-501, so it stands on a face receding from the front, about v 9.4-9.5 by the camera, short of the solved south corner at v 10.40

the stair cheeks' scrolls: the plate's cheeks end in their scrolls about 0.9 m up, each standing on a plain foot block to grade (x 300-345 and 420-460 px, y 640-700 px); K07's carved cheek rolls its scroll on grade (T-2984)
differences.how: T-2990: each roll stands on a plain foot block (K07's scrolled cheek learns `foot_block_m`), 0.7 m to the roll's underside, the roll 0.4 m across on it: the south cheek's roll lands at y 773-790 px against the plate's 775-792, the block's front under it to grade

differences.what: the stone's dressing: the bay's upper stage (above about 5.5 m) and the oriel are smooth ashlar, the rest rock-faced in large courses; the build lays the whole front rock-faced brown sandstone
differences.how: T-2987: the bay's K08 walls carry K08's rock-faced relief in large courses (0.6 m, blocks about 1.1 m) on its basement and ground storeys only (`masonry.to_m`, new), so it is rock-faced up to the band at 5.0 m (the plate's sill course at about y 575-580 px) and smooth ashlar over it; the oriel's walls are smooth K08 walling, as the plate's are. Its courses' joints are the kit's even rhythm. The oriel's rock-faced base is the oriel's own difference

differences.what: downpipes: two on the front, at the bay's south return and the entrance block's south corner; the build hangs none (a K01 gable roof carries no gutter yet)
differences.how: T-2987: K01's front_pipes (T-2953) on a gable roof, each from a rainwater head of its own: one beside the bay's south return at 5.7 m from the north corner (render x about 296 px against the plate's 298-302), one down the entrance block's south corner at 10.25 m (x about 500 against 505-510), each to a shoe over a splash stone at grade. Their heads stand at 7.85 m under the build's cornice, about 0.4 m under the plate's (whose cornice is higher there)

differences.what: the bay's stone gable's face: the plate lights its third storey through three flat-headed lights between colonnettes under a great round arch whose tympanum holds three small round-arched lights, with carving over it, the gable about 4 m across (its rake running out past the pinnacles' inner faces); the build's wall gable is 3.0 m across, its three lights flat-headed under voussoirs in a plain recessed panel, its face in the buff dressing stone (the plate's reads smooth ashlar of the front's stone) (T-1892)
differences.how: T-2936: K01's wall gable learns a GREAT ARCH. Its ring of fifteen voussoirs (1.15 m intrados, 0.16 m deep, 0.05 m proud) rises from the pediment's horizontal cornice, which reads as the plate's lintel over the lights below, its centre 0.3 m under the cornice's top so the ring springs as the plate's does, already curving; its intrados crown lands at about y 312 px with the plate's, its extrados about 10 px under the plate's. The tympanum is recessed 0.1 m and holds three round-arched lights, the middle one the taller (tops about y 323 and 330 px against the plate's 328 and 340); the three flat-headed lights below stand between four colonnettes with square bases and capitals under the cornice, and carry no voussoirs; a small round-arched light stands over the arch's crown (top about y 279 px against the plate's 262: the build's pediment is lower, being narrower); and the face, its ring and colonnettes are in the front's own brown sandstone, dressed smooth, not the buff dressing stone. What the plate still shows otherwise is the difference below (the gable's width, the archivolt's depth, the carving)

differences.what: the bay's stone gable's width: the plate's gable is about 4 m across, its rake running out past the pinnacles' inner faces, so its great arch spans about 145 px with a deep moulded archivolt and carved stone over it; the build's face is 3.0 m (K01 keeps each pinnacle clear of the K10 cornice's 0.13 m return), so its arch spans about 106 px and its ring is 0.16 m, the most the raking cornice leaves room for, and the carving is not built (T-2937)
differences.how: T-2937: the face 3.6 m across, its raking cornice's outer edge reaching the foot about 1.95 m either side, running out past the pinnacles' inner faces and dying into the shafts, which K01 now lets a wall gable's pinnacles do (`pinnacles.engage`: each shaft stands across the face's edge and 0.17 m past it); the apex at about y 213 px against the plate's 207, where T-2542's stood about 25 px under it; the pinnacles 0.5 m lower, their caps at y 293-300 px with the plate's right-hand cap at 293. The archivolt at the plate's depth across that width: a 1.4 m intrados centred 0.6 m under the cornice's top (its crown at about y 312 px against 315-318), 0.2 m voussoirs and a moulded hood order outside them 0.12 m wide and 0.1 m proud (`arch.hood`), 0.32 m in all against the plate's 14-16 px (0.32-0.36 m), its outer edge springing about 1.6 m either side (x about 140-280 px, the plate's about 128-270) and cresting at y 298 against 300-302. The tympanum's three lights at the plate's 0.8 m spacing and 0.4-0.42 m width; the flat-headed lights under the cornice at its 0.82 m spacing and 0.55 m width between their colonnettes. The carving over the arch is argued, not built: at the plate's resolution the pediment between the archivolt and the crown light reads as coursed rock-faced stone, its joints and shadows those of the courses, with no carved panel legible; the dark mass right of the crown is the tree's branches crossing it

differences.what: the bay's stone gable's centre: its apex, its lights and its pinnacles stand about 10 px (0.25 m) south of the plate's (the apex at x about 209 px against 196, the flat-headed lights' centre at 208 against 197), as T-2542 placed the gable on the bay's centre; and the plate's pinnacles are carved, the right-hand one capped by a scaled dome, the left by a moulded block, where the build's are square shafts under pyramids (T-2920)
the pierced (fretwork) stone balcony on the bay's deck in front of the third storey: not built; the bay's deck carries only its moulded cornice (T-1892)
differences.how: T-2916: K08's stone balustrade round the bay's flat deck, its cheeks and front: 0.7 m high, 0.3 m posts at its corners and against the wall, a 0.22 m coping and close-set stone bars at 0.12 m; its top lands at y about 395 px against the plate's coping at 392. The fretwork's interlace is not carved: the bars give its pierced light and shade

differences.what: the roof's shape: the plate's main roof reads as a steep hipped mass whose apex stands over the bay (x 320 px, about v 4 m), its south slope falling behind the oriel to a lower roof (top about 13 m) that runs to the tall stack; the build lays K01's one ridge along the whole front at 16.0 m, so it shows slate where the plate shows sky over the south half (x 400-500 px, y 240-340 px)
the oriel's height: its cornice stands at about 9.46 m against the plate's 9.06 m (about 18 px high), because K01 carries an oriel through the eave only 0.3 m past the eave datum (T-2989)

the stacks: the plate's tall stack with its corbelled cap on the south gable and the range's second stack (x about 545 px); the build's two plain stacks stand behind the ridge where this camera does not see them
colour: a monochrome print. The brown sandstone is the T-1837 register's reading
the north flank and the rear: the plate does not see them; built from the 1911 sheet's plan at the reconstructed tier
